canvas._sources: Motion library brief, 2026-10-05: HyperFrames compositions render at 1920x1080 and 24 fps (the canvas of our earlier prototype).

colors._sources: Night and paper, decided 2026-10-05. night, paper, ink, oxblood, verdigris, slate and paper_aged were chosen as a set (paper and ink for body text); gold and gold_dim are tuned values from our earlier prototype; loss and gain are the lifted oxblood and lifted verdigris, the meaning colours on night; scrim is a darker night; night_raised is derived (night lifted about 5 percent, paper on it is 10.9:1). No value was changed to pass contrast: every text pair in contrast.text_pairs passes as written.

fonts._sources: Motion library brief, 2026-10-05. Files and licences: assets/motion/fonts/FONTS.md (downloaded from google/fonts, ofl/newsreader, ofl/ibmplexsanscondensed, ofl/courierprime).

sizes._sources: min_text 48 and min_credit 30 are set by the motion library brief, 2026-10-05. The other sizes are derived: steps up from min_text, to be tuned against real frames (pixels at 1920x1080).

safe._sources: Derived: 5 percent of the canvas width (96 px) and height (54 px) on each side, the usual title-safe margin.

ease._sources: Motion library brief, 2026-10-05 (the motion research summary given with the brief; the underlying research source is not recorded in this repository). GSAP ease names.

duration._sources: Motion library brief, 2026-10-05 (the motion research summary given with the brief; the underlying research source is not recorded in this repository). lower_third_hold_min 4 and dissolve_min 0.5 match common practice (a lower third shown for 4 seconds, crossfade 0.5 seconds). Seconds.

camera._sources: Tuned values from our earlier prototype: MAX_PAN = 90.0 (output px per second, speed of the view's centre) and MAX_ZOOM = 0.085 (log scale per second, about 8.5 percent a second).

finish._sources: Tuned values from our earlier prototype: grain 0.13 and vignette 0.15.

limits._sources: Motion library brief, 2026-10-05: at most 6 elements moving at once; at most 3 flashes per second (the photosensitivity threshold of WCAG 2.3.1).

contrast._sources: WCAG 2.x, 4.5:1 for normal text (success criterion 1.4.3); the pairs are the text pairs the library draws. A pair whose foreground is listed under decorative is skipped: those colours are grounds and backings, never drawn as text. oxblood on paper_aged is 3.75:1 and is deliberately not a pair: oxblood is the accent on paper only.
